response.overview: As one sets off into the night, the other remains by a fire that threatens to go out. This is the story of a man—left by his partner—who tends to the dying embers. The director, playing himself, devises ways to survive his own misfortune. To save his skin—or perhaps to be reborn, who knows?—he turns on his camera. He offers us not only a mirror for our own distress, but also the luxury of a potential rebirth. Part immersion in nature, part road movie, the film draws us into a suspended moment, balanced between poetry and humor.
response.title: 6 Months, 6 Seconds
